title: Engineering & Technology part_of Edges v1
description: Structural part_of skeleton for the engineering-and-technology continent (parallel round 13c, after the node promotion PR #88): one membership edge per promoted node (31), targeting domain:engineering-and-technology or a field-level parent per gate-scheme nesting; section-12 part_of precedents (contradiction-nesting rule, depth rule, ASL-pillar pattern) and section 13 govern. Edges whose source node is proposed stay status-capped. Construction input only — not canonical graph data; edges only, zero new nodes.

include: part_of membership edges for the 31 engineering-technology skeleton nodes promoted in PR #88
Gate-scheme nesting analysis per edge (LCC class T subclass/range containment; UDC 62/66/67/68/69/60 division containment; FORD section 2 as cross-check)
Section-13 dual-membership candidates only where externally-sourced classification evidence exists (IR precedent)
Status caps: edges from proposed nodes (biomedical-engineering, food-engineering, naval-architecture-and-marine-engineering) stay at proposed
exclude: Modification of existing /data edges (the operations-research and control-theory re-target reviews are orchestrator promotion-time work, not generator output)
Cross-continent edges without classification evidence (parked section-13 candidates — photonics/optics, acoustics, plasma, robotics/AI, geodesy/geomatics — stay recorded, not written)
Edges into other round branches' nodes (architecture is 13d's; no engineering edge may target it from this batch)

notes: Round 13c edge batch (§12 pin d816cb6). Evidence sources are the registered source:lcc-outline, source:udc-summary, source:oecd-ford (no new source registration expected).

Pre-registered nesting questions: (1) hydraulic-engineering — neither gate scheme nests TC/626-627 under civil (both file them as direct engineering divisions); community housing is civil departments — contradiction-nesting analysis required; (2) construction-engineering — TH and UDC 69 are direct divisions (same pattern); (3) nuclear-engineering — LCC nests TK9001-9401 under TK (electrical) but UDC 621's caption places nuclear technology in the 621 mechanical-general umbrella — scheme-vs-scheme contradiction, flatten candidate; (4) automotive-engineering — TL1-484 and UDC 629.3 sit in the transport-vehicle wing, not under TJ/621 mechanical — community (SAE, ME departments) vs scheme filing; (5) metallurgy — LCC nests TN600-799 inside the TN mining subclass, UDC 669 is a direct division, community housing is materials departments — three-way question; (6) mining/manufacturing/systems/photonics/NAME — no gate-scheme nesting under any field: domain-direct flatten candidates with per-edge notes; (7) textile-engineering — both schemes nest inside the manufacturing wing (TS1300-1865 in TS; UDC 677 in 67): the depth rule allows subfield-under-subfield (ASL-pillar pattern); (8) petroleum-engineering and food-engineering — both schemes nest inside the chemical wing (TP ranges; UDC 665.6/664 in 66): chemical-engineering parents; (9) geomatics/robotics/telecommunications/computer-engineering — single-scheme LCC nesting with the other scheme silent: un-contradicted nesting may deepen (CIS depth rule).

Section-13 candidates are written only on passing the evidence gate at QC; all currently-parked candidates (photonics/optics, acoustics, plasma, robotics/AI, computer-engineering/CS, geodesy via geomatics) default to recorded-not-written.

The operations-research and control-theory domain-direct membership edges (existing /data, session #7) are re-target-reviewed by the orchestrator at promotion time (mathematics-education precedent) — generator must not emit edges for them.
/data remains the source of truth for accepted graph data.
